main.summary: Internal helper for atomically creating files without overwriting existing destinations.

method.name: Write
method.summary: Write content to a unique staging file beside the destination, then publish it with a create-only move.
method.param: Callback that writes the complete file contents to the staging stream.
Whether to create the destination directory when it does not exist.
method.returns: True if the staged file was published; false if the destination already exists, including when another writer creates it during publication.
method.remarks: The staging file is created in the destination directory, flushed, closed, and moved without overwrite. Unpublished staging files are removed on failure.
